Dana (Support): Heads-up  Tenant 'atlas-ai' can't finish activation, API returns 403 on activate endpoint. Ticket #9921. AE Marco flagged for priority.
Ravi (CS): I'm taking owner for customer contact. Dana, paste the API error and trace id.
Dana (Support): Error payload: {"code":403,"err":"insufficient_key_scope"}. Trace: trc-9921. Key id: k_trial_atlas_01. Console click shows 'Permission denied'.
Liam (Engineering): Likely onboarding job minted a trial key without write scope. If confirmed, we can mint a short-lived test key during the call.
Sofia (Enablement): I can run a 15-min screen share to walk the customer while we triage. Suggest comms plan: quick acknowledgement + immediate 15m slot, offer manual activation attempt.
AE - Marco: Customer says demo tomorrow; please prioritize and CC me on updates. Offer a 2-week extension if we miss the demo.
Ravi (CS): Plan: 1) Reach out to customer within 15m and schedule 15m triage. 2) If scope issue, request temp key from Engineering (Liam) during call. 3) If not resolved in 2h, escalate to SEV and arrange extension (AE Marco). Owners assigned.
Dana (Support): Scheduling invite now. I will also attach repro steps and the support console logs.
Liam (Engineering): I'll standby and can approve a scoped test key if needed.
Ravi (CS): Thanks team  I'll update after the call.
